title: Coordinator+
description: A client-side remake and companion mod for my plugin Coordinator!
body:
**Highly customisible (soon TM) bossbar like compass element.**

![Showcase of the element](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/44b637461cea1e40265f0d07e8e03793c024d989.png)

Currently it can show your facing direction, coordinates and how will your coordinates change when going a certain direction.

Future plans are to add integration with the original plugin Coordinator, adding a switch between clientside and server side data. Also I want to add full texture pack / config customization.

This is a Beta limited in functionality and serves as a proof of concept, I'll be waiting for your feadback.
